# Ops

Every operation in pixel3d. The GUI, CLI, MCP server, scripts, addons and the node graph all call these.

## scene

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`scene.create_empty`](scene.create_empty.md) | Creates an empty object: a transform for grouping parts or marking a pivot. |
| [`scene.delete`](scene.delete.md) | Deletes an object, with its children unless recursive is false. |
| [`scene.duplicate`](scene.duplicate.md) | Duplicates an object as an independent copy or as an instance sharing its mesh. |
| [`scene.rename`](scene.rename.md) | Renames an object; paths of its children change with it. |
| [`scene.parent`](scene.parent.md) | Moves an object under a parent so it follows the parent's transform. |
| [`scene.unparent`](scene.unparent.md) | Moves an object to the top level of the scene. |
| [`scene.set_transform`](scene.set_transform.md) | Sets or adjusts an object's position, rotation (degrees) and scale relative to its parent. |
| [`scene.apply_transform`](scene.apply_transform.md) | Bakes an object's position, rotation and/or scale into its mesh, leaving the world shape unchanged. |
| [`scene.set_origin`](scene.set_origin.md) | Moves an object's origin (pivot) without moving its geometry in the world. |
| [`scene.tag`](scene.tag.md) | Adds or removes tags such as high, low, collision or lod1 on an object. |
| [`scene.set_metadata`](scene.set_metadata.md) | Sets or removes free-form JSON metadata on an object. |
| [`scene.join`](scene.join.md) | Merges several mesh objects, or several curve objects, into one, keeping their world shapes. |
| [`scene.separate`](scene.separate.md) | Splits a mesh object into several objects by loose part, material or face group. |

## io

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`io.import`](io.import.md) | Reads a glTF, GLB, OBJ or FBX file into the scene, in meters with +Y up, repairing its meshes. |

## prim

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`prim.box`](prim.box.md) | Creates a box with optional rounded or chamfered edges and groups top, bottom, front, back, left, right. |
| [`prim.cylinder`](prim.cylinder.md) | Creates a cylinder along Y with quad-grid, n-gon, fan or open caps and groups side, cap_top, cap_bottom. |
| [`prim.cone`](prim.cone.md) | Creates a pointed cone or a frustum (truncated cone) along Y with groups side, cap_top, cap_bottom. |
| [`prim.quad_sphere`](prim.quad_sphere.md) | Creates a sphere of even quads with no poles (a projected subdivided cube). |
| [`prim.uv_sphere`](prim.uv_sphere.md) | Creates a latitude-longitude sphere with quads between parallels and triangle fans at both poles. |
| [`prim.ico_sphere`](prim.ico_sphere.md) | Creates a geodesic sphere of nearly equal triangles (a subdivided icosahedron). |
| [`prim.torus`](prim.torus.md) | Creates a torus (ring, donut) lying flat in the XZ plane, all quads. |
| [`prim.tube`](prim.tube.md) | Creates a hollow cylinder (pipe with wall thickness) with groups outer, inner, cap_top, cap_bottom. |
| [`prim.capsule`](prim.capsule.md) | Creates a capsule (a cylinder with round ends) of quads only, with groups side, cap_top, cap_bottom. |
| [`prim.wedge`](prim.wedge.md) | Creates a wedge (ramp) whose slope runs down toward the front, with groups bottom, back, slope, left, right. |
| [`prim.plane`](prim.plane.md) | Creates a flat grid of quads in the XZ plane facing up (+Y). |

## curve

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`curve.polyline`](curve.polyline.md) | Creates a curve object from straight segments through points, open or closed. |
| [`curve.bezier`](curve.bezier.md) | Creates a smooth cubic Bezier curve through points, with automatic or explicit handles. |
| [`curve.circle`](curve.circle.md) | Creates a closed circular curve: a regular polygon of the given number of points in a plane. |
| [`curve.rectangle`](curve.rectangle.md) | Creates a closed rectangular curve centered on its origin, optionally with rounded corners. |
| [`curve.resample`](curve.resample.md) | Replaces each spline with a polyline of points evenly spaced by arc length. |
| [`curve.offset`](curve.offset.md) | Moves each spline sideways by a distance within its plane, with mitered or beveled corners. |
| [`curve.fillet`](curve.fillet.md) | Rounds every corner of each spline with a tangent arc, or chamfers it with one segment. |

## gen

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`gen.lathe`](gen.lathe.md) | Revolves a profile around an axis into a round object with groups side, cap_top, cap_bottom and profile_<i>. |
| [`gen.extrude_shape`](gen.extrude_shape.md) | Turns a flat outline with holes into a solid of a given depth, with optional round or chamfered rims. |
| [`gen.sweep`](gen.sweep.md) | Carries a cross section along a path into rails, trims, frames, handles and cables, with twist and taper. |
| [`gen.pipe`](gen.pipe.md) | Builds a round pipe along a path with smooth bends at the corners and quad caps. |
| [`gen.loft`](gen.loft.md) | Builds a surface through a sequence of cross sections, resampling them so their point counts match. |
| [`gen.array`](gen.array.md) | Repeats a mesh in a line, around an axis or along a curve, welding copies that touch. |
| [`gen.mirror`](gen.mirror.md) | Adds the mirror image of a mesh across an axis plane, welding the seam; optionally bisects first. |
| [`gen.scatter`](gen.scatter.md) | Places seeded, evenly spaced instances of an object over a surface, standing on it with random turns and scales. |

## sdf

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`sdf.mesh`](sdf.mesh.md) | Builds an organic shape from named primitives blended in order (smooth unions, cuts) into a closed quad mesh. |
| [`sdf.from_mesh`](sdf.from_mesh.md) | Rebuilds a closed mesh from its distance field as even quads about `detail` apart (a voxel remesh). |

## remesh

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`remesh.quad`](remesh.quad.md) | Rebuilds a closed mesh as all quads with even edges that follow a smooth direction field. |

## select

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`select.save`](select.save.md) | Stores the elements a selector picks as a named group on the mesh. |
| [`select.grow`](select.grow.md) | Adds the neighbouring rings of elements to a group (faces across edges, edges and vertices through vertices). |
| [`select.shrink`](select.shrink.md) | Removes the outermost rings of elements from a group. |
| [`select.group_delete`](select.group_delete.md) | Removes a named group; the geometry stays. |
| [`select.group_rename`](select.group_rename.md) | Renames a named group, keeping its elements and position in the list. |

## edit

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`edit.extrude`](edit.extrude.md) | Pulls faces out along their normals (or a direction) and joins them to the surface with side walls. |
| [`edit.inset`](edit.inset.md) | Shrinks faces inward within their surface, leaving a rim of quads, and optionally pushes the inner part in or out. |
| [`edit.poke`](edit.poke.md) | Splits each face into a fan of triangles around a new center vertex, optionally raised into a pyramid. |
| [`edit.triangulate`](edit.triangulate.md) | Splits quads and n-gons into triangles with the diagonals that keep angles largest (beauty), adding no vertices. |
| [`edit.tris_to_quads`](edit.tris_to_quads.md) | Joins pairs of adjacent triangles into quads, best-shaped pairs first, where the result is flat and square enough. |
| [`edit.split`](edit.split.md) | Detaches faces from the rest of the mesh by duplicating the vertices along the border, leaving them in place. |
| [`edit.flip`](edit.flip.md) | Reverses the facing of every connected part that contains a selected face. |
| [`edit.subdivide`](edit.subdivide.md) | Splits faces into quads at edge and face middles without moving anything (flat subdivision). |
| [`edit.loop_cut`](edit.loop_cut.md) | Cuts new edge loops across the ring of quads that runs through the selected edges. |
| [`edit.bridge`](edit.bridge.md) | Joins two holes (boundary loops) with a band of quads. |
| [`edit.merge`](edit.merge.md) | Merges selected vertices into one point (center) or each connected run into its own point (collapse). |
| [`edit.merge_by_distance`](edit.merge_by_distance.md) | Welds vertices that lie closer together than a distance, closing seams between joined or mirrored parts. |
| [`edit.dissolve`](edit.dissolve.md) | Removes vertices, edges or faces while keeping the surface closed, merging the faces around them into polygons. |
| [`edit.plane_cut`](edit.plane_cut.md) | Cuts the mesh along a plane, optionally removing one side and capping the opening. |
| [`edit.symmetrize`](edit.symmetrize.md) | Makes a mesh mirror-symmetric: keeps one half and replaces the other with its mirror image, welded at the seam. |
| [`edit.boolean`](edit.boolean.md) | Cuts other mesh objects out of a mesh, adds them to it, or keeps only the overlap, with clean polygons. |
| [`edit.thicken`](edit.thicken.md) | Gives surfaces a wall thickness: an offset back side joined to the front along open borders. |
| [`edit.smooth`](edit.smooth.md) | Smooths vertex positions without shrinking the shape (Taubin smoothing). |
| [`edit.bevel`](edit.bevel.md) | Rounds or chamfers edges: each edge becomes a strip of faces `width` wide, with caps where strips meet or end. |
| [`edit.transform`](edit.transform.md) | Moves, rotates and scales selected vertices, edges or faces of a mesh, optionally with proportional editing. |
| [`edit.shrink_fatten`](edit.shrink_fatten.md) | Moves vertices along their normals: positive fattens (outward), negative shrinks. |
| [`edit.edge_slide`](edit.edge_slide.md) | Slides edges (an edge loop) along the surface toward the neighbouring edges on one side. |
| [`edit.fill`](edit.fill.md) | Closes holes (loops of boundary edges) with one face each. |
| [`edit.recalc_normals`](edit.recalc_normals.md) | Makes every connected part of a mesh face outward (or inward), flipping parts that face the wrong way. |
| [`edit.delete_elements`](edit.delete_elements.md) | Deletes the selected faces (or every face using the selected edges or vertices) and anything left unused. |

## shade

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`shade.smooth_by_angle`](shade.smooth_by_angle.md) | Shades smoothly across gentle edges and keeps edges sharper than an angle hard. |
| [`shade.mark_sharp`](shade.mark_sharp.md) | Marks edges sharp: shading breaks there (hard edges). |
| [`shade.clear_sharp`](shade.clear_sharp.md) | Clears the sharp mark from edges so shading flows smoothly across them. |
| [`shade.set_flat`](shade.set_flat.md) | Shades faces flat (faceted) by marking all their edges sharp. |
| [`shade.set_smooth`](shade.set_smooth.md) | Shades faces smoothly by clearing the sharp mark on the edges between them. |
| [`shade.weighted_normals`](shade.weighted_normals.md) | Sets custom normals weighted by face area so large flat faces stay flat-shaded next to small bevel faces. |
| [`shade.crease`](shade.crease.md) | Sets how sharp edges stay under `subd.catmull_clark`: 0 rounds them, 1 keeps them sharp. |

## subd

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`subd.catmull_clark`](subd.catmull_clark.md) | Smooths the whole mesh by Catmull-Clark subdivision, keeping creased edges sharp. |

## deform

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`deform.bend`](deform.bend.md) | Curls a shape along an axis onto a circular arc, turning by an angle over its length. |
| [`deform.twist`](deform.twist.md) | Twists a shape around an axis, from no turn at its low end to `angle` at its high end. |
| [`deform.taper`](deform.taper.md) | Scales a shape toward its axis progressively, from full size at its low end to `factor` at its high end. |
| [`deform.displace`](deform.displace.md) | Moves vertices along their normals by seeded fractal noise (bumps, rocks, terrain, organic variation). |

## cleanup

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`cleanup.auto`](cleanup.auto.md) | Makes a mesh clean in one call: welds seams, collapses degenerate faces, removes specks and hidden parts, fills small holes, joins flat triangles into quads and turns parts outward. |
| [`cleanup.report`](cleanup.report.md) | Reports a mesh's topology problems and what cleanup.auto would fix, without changing anything. |

## expect

| Op | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`expect.add`](expect.add.md) | Adds a test for the model (size, symmetry, attachment, no intersections, budget, watertight) that runs after every change. |
| [`expect.remove`](expect.remove.md) | Removes an expectation by name. |
